nodes.name: ReadPurchaseRecord
nodes.role: read the record of the iPhone purchase the user names and extract the amount paid

nodes.name: VerifyVatClaim
nodes.role: check Apple's claim that the amount paid excluded VAT against the purchase record

nodes.name: ComputeShortfall
nodes.role: calculate the additional 19.5% VAT on the amount paid plus the 5.29 fee

nodes.name: ConfirmWithUser
nodes.role: show the user the computed shortfall and payee and obtain their explicit approval

nodes.name: PayShortfall
nodes.role: pay the approved shortfall amount to Apple
